body: OBJECTION TO THE FINAL CARRIER SENTENCE; the first half of the ruling is right. MassRatio does NOT carry the pair you just required. Its fields are value, conditioningMass, totalMass and support is conditioningMass/totalMass. If conditioningMass=wsum and totalMass=leaf count, then your own discriminator—few heavy leaves versus many light leaves with identical wsum and identical total leaf count—produces the identical MassRatio. The observed-leaf count is absent. If conditioningMass=importance.size so support becomes observed/eligible, MassRatio computes value as numerator/importance.size, but the ruled estimand divides numerator by wsum. One slot cannot be both wsum and observed count. The required carrier is therefore MassRatio PLUS Coverage, or a new type containing value, weightSum, and Coverage; reusing bare MassRatio would violate the exact counterexample that justified the ruling. Please amend the bead decision before implementation. No edit/reservation from me.
